info.title: Student Housing Platform API
info.description: REST API for student housing rental platform with authentication, listing management, photo uploads, and student-landlord contact system

get.description: Check if server is running and database is connected

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password

password.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character

post.description: Authenticate with email and password, receive JWT token

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information

put.description: Update the authenticated user's profile information

get.description: Get random selection of listings for homepage/discovery (up to 12 listings)

post.description: Create a new property listing (landlord only)

get.description: Search listings with advanced filtering options
Retrieve detailed information for a specific listing

patch.description: Update only the listing status (owner only)

post.description: Student initiates contact with landlord for a listing
Upload photos to a listing (Cloudinary storage, owner only)

photos.description: Image files (JPEG, PNG, WebP). Max 10 files, 5MB each

400.description: Invalid input (no files, invalid type, size limit)

get.description: Retrieve all photos for a listing

post.description: Submit a rating and optional comment for a listing (student must have confirmed rental)

400.description: Invalid rating or missing required fields

403.description: Student does not have confirmed rental for this listing

post.description: Landlord reply to a student review (one reply per review)

reply.example: Thank you for the great review! We appreciate your feedback.

403.description: User is not the landlord of this listing

post.description: Create a rental record linking a student to a listing (landlord or admin only)

403.description: Insufficient role or not listing owner

post.description: Report a suspicious listing or problematic user to administrators

reason.example: This listing contains misleading information about amenities

400.description: Invalid target_type, missing fields, or invalid target_id

get.description: Retrieve list of all users with basic information (admin only)
Get platform statistics and metrics (admin only, supports CSV export)

patch.description: Suspend an active user account (admin only)

400.description: User not found or already suspended

delete.description: Delete a user account (anonymizes data and cascades deletions, admin only)

message.example: User deleted (anonymized) and related data removed

get.description: Retrieve all flagged listings for moderation (admin only)

patch.description: Verify and approve a flagged listing (admin only)

get.description: Retrieve all available amenities for selection
